name: Modern house with garage (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Two-storey modern house, 10.4 x 9 m, with an attached single garage on the east side (13.8 x 9 m overall): grey brick ground floor, dark vertical timber cladding above with charcoal-rendered ends, a flat parapet roof, a steel door canopy, a sectional garage door. Enterable: living room and kitchen below, two bedrooms above, two stairs off the rear landing; the garage (utility) opens from the kitchen and by its own door.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
